script: If you were to Google Eli Ellis, you would see that he's a high-volume scorer. High-volume scorer means absolutely nothing except a guy who's been given a bunch of shots. When Eli Ellis got to South Carolina, they didn't give him a bunch of shots. So now all of a sudden he's just a scorer. And then Eli Ellis was only 6-foot, he can't score on everybody, so he's just kind of a scorer. And then Eli Ellis doesn't play any defense, so he's a one-trick pony. But I thought Eli Ellis was a 32-point-a-game scorer, and he was the Overtime Elite greatest player ever. I thought that Eli Ellis was supposed to be a star. I thought Eli Ellis was a 4-star recruit. 60 days from today Eli Ellis will be in the portal asking a mid-major university if they're gonna let him take 30 shots for their team. There's no such thing as a high-volume scorer. It's just a guy taking a bunch of shots. Eli Ellis's role on the basketball floor doesn't exist.
